attendance.note: NT Independent (7 Aug 2025), verified on page 21 Oct 2026: the 2024 festival resulted in '177,136 attendances at various events' (cumulative across the program; unattributed in the article). The festival's PR agency Access PR gives 177,134 (search result; page returned 404). Earlier figure: 170,008 attendances and 39,361 tickets for 2022 (Tourism and Events NT, 7 Dec 2022).

add_sources.note: Verified on page 21 Oct 2026: '177,136 attendances at various events' for the previous (2024) festival; article dated 7 Aug 2025.
Every organiser page title (site crawl 20 Oct 2026) reads 'Darwin Festival - 4 August - 22 August 2027'. 4 Aug 2027 is a Wednesday, so the FAQ's 'Wednesday 5' is a typo.

Verified on page 21 Oct 2026: major partners for 2022 included Santos and INPEX; Santos held naming rights to the opening concert and pulled its sponsorship in October 2022 after nearly three decades.
